sinopsis.es: Un thriller psicológico de tensión lenta y deliberada que explota en un final que nadie anticipa. Oscuro, preciso e inquietante: un debut que anuncia a un cineasta con algo verdadero que decir.
sinopsis.en: A slow-burn psychological thriller that builds its tension quietly and deliberately before detonating in a final act nobody sees coming. Dark, precise, and unsettling — a debut that announces a filmmaker with something real to say.
